dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You should cut the rookies some slack.

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: Absolutely not. On a job like this, where you're constantly surrounded by danger, what each person does affects the survival of everyone. Even the rookies need to understand that.

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: The Wild Hunt won't spare you just because you're a rookie. A single moment of complacency can lead to consequences you can't undo later.

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: Discipline is our last line of defense at times like that.
